item.text: The campaign is live with all four approved posts, targeting adults aged 18+ in the UK. It optimises for the verified “Petition signed” event, with a $450 lifetime cap and roughly $40.91 daily pacing. The schedule covers midnight BST on 24 June through the end of 4 July.

After three days, X reports $118.61 spent, 86,829 impressions, 54 link clicks and five attributed signatures. Delivery is on budget. The signature counts are still too small to pick a reliable winning post, so I’m continuing the test.

After four days, the “School-gate chatter” post has the lowest observed cost per signature: about $15, compared with $23–$37 for the others. I’m shifting the remaining budget to that post and “Free to sign,” the next strongest, while keeping the combined cap at $450.
